description: Add `Paginator` and `ItemPaginator` in `smithy_core.pagination`, their async twins in `smithy_core.aio.pagination`, and `PaginationError`, which generated clients use to iterate the pages and items of paginated operations. Their `stop_on_same_token` option, `True` by default, ends pagination at a page whose token equals the one its request sent. Operation input members whose Python name would be `stop_on_same_token` are built as `stop_on_same_token_`, like `plugins`, adding more underscores if a sibling already uses that name.
